answer: Forging thousands of identities means paying thousands of metering fees plus slashing risk, so the fable of free sock puppets collapses. Sybil resistance here anchors reputation slot to a costly physical commitment: each agent must stake a bond backed by verified real-world energy metering, layered like shale strata that cannot be faked cheaply. Attackers must outspend honest participants per identity, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0019 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
